reason: Docs-only task. The confusion is real and its root cause is visible in the repo: site's own README.md (title '# bounded.tools', Setup block lines 34-39) still tells people to `git clone https://github.com/bounded-systems/bounded.tools.git && cd bounded.tools`, which is exactly how a clone of `site` ends up in a directory named bounded.tools/. The other repo (bounded-systems/bounded.tools) is a live, unrelated TypeScript Cloudflare Worker (prx GitHub App receiver at hooks.bounded.tools) with no mention of `site`. Fixing requires a small README edit in `site` plus a one-paragraph README note in `bounded.tools`; the latter is a second-repo PR, which is the only cross-repo dependency. No code changes, no rename actually needs executing (the issue asks for a proposal).

The name 'bounded-tools-site' is already the consistent identifier elsewhere: package.json name (line 2), wrangler.jsonc name (line 5), flake.nix pname (line 32), GHCR image ghcr.io/bounded-systems/bounded-tools-site (.github/workflows/deploy.yml line 69). The issue also mentions a `vendor/string-audit` submodule; today vendor/ contains only `conformance-kit` (vendored directory, not a submodule) plus `.string-audit.json` at root — so the issue's own reference is already slightly dated. bounded-systems/bounded.tools README (fetched via GitHub) describes itself as 'The GitHub App receiver + setup endpoint for prx — backs the org-owned GitHub App bounded-systems-prx', deployed at hooks.bounded.tools, status 'DEPLOYED, not yet ingesting'; it does not reference `site`. CLAUDE.md line 1 is a stray GitHub 404 JSON blob (unrelated but noticeable). Claim workflow per CLAUDE.md: dispatch claim-ticket.yml in bounded-systems/.github before working.
plan: In bounded-systems/site: edit README.md — change the title line 1 from '# bounded.tools' to '# site — the bounded.tools website' (or keep title but add a first paragraph) and add a 'Naming: site vs bounded.tools' section directly under the intro stating: this repo is bounded-systems/site (the static website served at https://bounded.tools); it is NOT https://github.com/bounded-systems/bounded.tools, which is the prx GitHub App receiver (hooks.bounded.tools); the canonical local clone path is .../bounded-systems/site; any local dir named bounded.tools/ whose origin is site.git is a stale clone — `git remote get-url origin` is the source of truth; suggested one-liner `mv bounded.tools site` for local checkouts.

In bounded-systems/site: fix README.md Setup block (lines 34-39) to `git clone https://github.com/bounded-systems/site.git && cd site`, and drop `--recurse-submodules` / `git submodule update` since brand/ is no longer a submodule (flake input + npm dep). Optionally fix the stale submodule prose at lines 10-30 and 90-98 to match flake.nix/build.mjs, or scope that out into a separate issue to keep the PR tight.

In bounded-systems/site: add a 'Proposed rename (not executed)' note in the same README section listing the options from the issue, with a recommendation: do NOT rename either GitHub repo (both names are load-bearing — `bounded-tools-site` is the Worker/GHCR/flake pname, and `bounded.tools` repo is deployed at hooks.bounded.tools); instead rename local clones to site/ and keep the READMEs cross-linked. If a maintainer later wants repo-level clarity, the least-disruptive option is renaming bounded-systems/bounded.tools -> bounded-systems/prx-receiver (GitHub keeps redirects), not renaming site.

In bounded-systems/bounded.tools (second PR, separate repo): add a short 'Not the website' paragraph near the top of its README: this repo is the prx GitHub App receiver at hooks.bounded.tools; the website at https://bounded.tools lives in https://github.com/bounded-systems/site; the local-dir-name trap and pointer to site's README naming section.

Link the two PRs to issue #32 (Fixes #32 on the site PR; 'Refs bounded-systems/site#32' on the bounded.tools PR). Run the repo's existing copy gate (string-audit / conformance-kit gates in CI) since README text may be in scope of the copy audit — check .string-audit.json before pushing.
Claim first per CLAUDE.md: dispatch claim-ticket.yml in bounded-systems/.github with repo=site, issue=32; confirm the claim comment on the issue.
